title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to easily access and manipulate request data. It will provide a robust way to parse request bodies, handling various content types and edge cases. By including this feature, yantraverse will become more versatile and user-friendly
acceptance: The feature is considered complete when request bodies are correctly parsed for JSON and URL-encoded content types, and error handling is implemented for invalid or unsupported content types
reason: Adding request body parsing will significantly improve the framework's usability and functionality, making it more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
